I went there a year ago to buy some things, but the staff were incredibly lazy. I really didn't like the service. I bought a lot of things, they saw me, and they couldn't even offer me a bag, not even one that cost $10 or $15. They had such a lazy attitude, and they were two young women who said they were on their lunch break or something. I was obviously annoyed. If they don't want to work, they should give that job to someone who actually needs it. Hire people who know how to work and have a positive attitude. I don't even want to go back. Next time I'll go to the other branch. Only one guy was friendly; he was blond and had a nice attitude. The others were just so lazy. Be very careful about this, because I'm not from Mexico City, and I went on a recommendation, but what a shame about the employees. Their terrible service is only hurting the business.

I went today and there's a great variety. I went for aprons; the service was very good, and if you ask questions or aren't sure, they explain everything. The prices are excellent. I bought three aprons and they were super affordable, and they're exactly the same as the ones I bought at Petco before. I highly recommend them. I don't know if there are cheaper stores, but this one, with the discount and other things I bought, came to about $100 each. It's a great place to start a business.
